name: =LOVE — The Audition, 2017
background_en: As active idol and producer 指原莉乃, choose a new group from a 103-person final audition pool, manage limited time and imperfect information, train your chosen members, and bring them to their first public stage at TIF.
background_zh: 身为现役偶像兼制作人指原莉乃，从103人的最终甄选中挑选并组建新团体，在信息不完整、时间有限的情况下训练成员，并带领她们登上TIF的初舞台。
